# `r cv_section_icon("briefcase")` Professional Experience

```{r experience}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

experience <- tribble(
  ~ Degree, ~ Year, ~ Institution, ~ Where,
  "Postdoctoral Research Associate", "2024 - Present", "University of Sheffield", "Sheffield, UK"
) 

cv_entries(experience, with = "Degree", when = "Year",
           what = "Institution", where = "Where")
```
